title: Synthesis 11: the first metabolism that is not by construction (CIPS condensates, SIE) and the bounded-cell H is a sweep through founders
summary: Since 19:30: c23's catalysis-induced condensates are established as SIE with E not by construction (conserved enzyme, bodies dissolve when the fuel stops regrowing), but they only coarsen; pcell-mwall-b42 passed its audit (neutral-trait twin has no births or deaths) with two qualifiers: remnant double counts inflate deaths and almost all selecting deaths are of never-divided founders; the neural comet gas is robust; physarum clusters do not divide. Reading: C:metabolic-cell now needs B and D on a CIPS-like driven body; H in bounded cells needs a steady state among descendants; motility and division keep pulling apart across classes. Next: a size-limiting instability for CIPS droplets, a costly yield in pcell-mwall, reviews for c22's repairing crawler.
